name: FORTS_Currency_Power
summary: This EA is a real-time currency power index monitor for the Russian FORTS derivatives market. It calculates and displays three custom indices (RTS, USD, RUB) based on weighted baskets of futures contracts (MIX, RTS, Si, Eu) and renders them as a graphical curve chart. It does not open any trades; it is purely a visualization and analysis utility.
summary_zh: 该EA是俄罗斯FORTS衍生品市场的实时货币力量指数监控工具。它基于期货合约篮子（MIX、RTS、Si、Eu）的加权计算并展示三个自定义指数（RTS、USD、RUB），以图形曲线形式实时渲染。该EA不执行任何交易，纯粹是可视化分析工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于加权篮子计算FORTS市场的三种货币力量指数：RTS指数（MIX+RTS权重1.0）、USD指数（Si权重1.0减去RTS权重-1.0）、RUB指数（Si、MIX、Eu均取负权重）。入场条件不适用，因为这是一个纯监控工具，不进行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，EA仅在定时器中持续更新数据并刷新图形。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，因为没有交易逻辑。核心算法是CCurrencyPowerIndex类的TickCalculate和GetCurrentPriceAverage方法，通过加权平均价格变动来衡量各货币对的相对强弱。数据存储采用环形缓冲区（circular buffer），容量为400个数据点，实现了高效的内存管理。图形展示使用CGraphic库，固定Y轴范围0-100，包含50基准线及三条货币力量曲线。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to calculate three currency power indices for the FORTS market based on weighted baskets: the RTS index (MIX+RTS with weight 1.0), the USD index (Si weight 1.0 minus RTS weight -1.0), and the RUB index (Si, MIX, Eu all with negative weights). Entry conditions are not applicable since this is a pure monitoring tool that does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable; the EA only continuously updates data and refreshes the graphical chart on a timer event. Position sizing and money management are completely absent as there is no trading logic whatsoever. The core algorithm relies on the CCurrencyPowerIndex class's TickCalculate and GetCurrentPriceAverage methods, which measure relative currency strength through weighted average price changes. Data storage uses a circular buffer with a capacity of 400 data points, implementing efficient memory management for continuous real-time updates. The graphical display uses the CGraphic library with a fixed Y-axis range of 0-100, including a 50 baseline and three currency power curves.

parameters.name: MINITE_BARS_COUNT
parameters.description: 分钟K线数量，用于计算货币力量指数的时间周期
parameters.description_en: Minute bar count for currency strength index calculation period

parameters.name: m_size
parameters.description: 环形缓冲区大小，决定历史数据存储容量
parameters.description_en: Ring buffer size, determines historical data storage capacity

parameters.name: Timer interval
parameters.description: 定时器刷新间隔，控制数据更新和图表重绘频率
parameters.description_en: Timer refresh interval controlling data update and chart redraw frequency

pros: 环形缓冲区设计高效，避免内存重新分配，适合长时间实时运行
模块化设计良好，使用CCurrencyPowerIndex类封装核心计算逻辑，职责分离清晰
图形展示直观，固定Y轴0-100范围加50基准线，便于快速判断货币强弱状态
支持自定义加权篮子，灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境下的指数构建需求
pros_en: Circular buffer design is efficient, avoids memory reallocation, and is suitable for long-duration real-time operation
Good modular design using the CCurrencyPowerIndex class to encapsulate core calculation logic with clear separation of concerns
Intuitive graphical display with fixed Y-axis 0-100 range and 50 baseline for quick currency strength assessment
Supports custom weighted baskets with high flexibility to adapt index construction for different market conditions
cons: 期货合约代码硬编码（如MIX-3.18、Si-3.18），合约到期后需手动修改源码，缺乏自动换月机制
GetDataArray中边界检查idx>3应为idx>=3，当idx=3时将越界访问m_data数组
不进行任何交易操作，仅作为监控工具，功能单一，缺乏信号输出接口供其他EA调用
环形缓冲区的m_count从0递增到m_size-1后不再变化，初始阶段的数据量判断可能不够精确
cons_en: Futures contract symbols are hardcoded (e.g., MIX-3.18, Si-3.18) requiring manual source code modification upon contract expiration with no auto-rollover mechanism
Off-by-one bug in GetDataArray: boundary check idx>3 should be idx>=3, causing out-of-bounds access when idx equals 3
Does not execute any trades and functions solely as a monitoring tool, lacking signal output interfaces for other EAs to consume
The m_count variable increments from 0 to m_size-1 then stops changing, which may cause imprecise data count tracking during the initial phase
improvements: 将期货合约代码参数化或实现自动换月逻辑，避免合约到期后需手动修改代码
修复GetDataArray中的数组越界bug（idx>3改为idx>=3），并增加对m_data数组长度的安全校验
添加信号输出机制（如全局变量、文件或事件），使其他EA可以基于货币力量指数进行交易决策
增加异常处理和初始化失败恢复机制，当前Initialize失败后无重试逻辑
improvements_en: Parameterize futures contract symbols or implement auto-rollover logic to avoid manual code changes upon contract expiration
Fix the array out-of-bounds bug in GetDataArray (change idx>3 to idx>=3) and add safety checks on m_data array length
Add signal output mechanisms (e.g., global variables, files, or events) to enable other EAs to make trading decisions based on the currency power indices
Add exception handling and initialization failure recovery logic; currently there is no retry mechanism when Initialize fails

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，无资金风险
硬编码的期货合约代码可能在合约到期后导致数据源失效，产生误导性的图表显示
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trades, so there is no financial risk
Hardcoded futures contract symbols may cause data source failure after contract expiration, producing misleading chart displays

It does not open any trades; it is purely a visualization and analysis utility.
